comments.body:
The +1 Crafts Trading English Hood (black coloured one)English Hood was available at the Young Woman near the Mogul in London during the 16.1 World Clock period.

Importantly though - it required 10 Cotton Fabric and not Silk Fabric as is indicated by the recipe here.
